name: "… instead" riders — each branch on its own condition (For the Family, Ray of Enfeeblement, Éowyn, Might of the Meek); "with toxic" lists Toxic 2
notes: Memory: project_audit_target_changes_nothing_2026-10-11. Found by tests/audit.py. With four or more creatures For the Family gives +4/+4 and not +2/+2 as well. Ray of Enfeeblement ("If that creature is white, it gets -4/-4 … instead") is a rider about "it" written as "that creature": -4/-4 on the white Lions, -4/-1 on the green Bears. Éowyn, Lady of Rohan's fired option reads "If target creature is equipped, target creature gains first strike and vigilance … instead": an unequipped target gets first strike alone (it used to get nothing, and the equipped branch lost its duplicate first strike to the keyword de-duplication). Might of the Meek's "It also gets +1/+0 … if you control a Mouse" no longer gates the trample or reaches every creature. Necrogen Rotpriest's "target creature you control with toxic" lists itself (Toxic 2) — the keyword filter compared whole lines.
